Title: Development Agreement
Abstract: This Development Agreement is entered into on April 15, 2010 by and between Cargill, Incorporated and Bioamber S.A.S. The agreement outlines the scope of work, fees, milestones, confidentiality, intellectual property rights, and other terms and conditions for the development of a yeast strain designated CB1 for fermenting dextrose and/or mixed sugar streams to produce succinic acid and salts thereof.
